notes.title: Patch Notes for November 12th
notes.notes:
Good day archaeologists!

Today we have a minor patch for the current QoL-Update for you! This one not only fixes some minor issues with players getting stuck in rare cases, but also brings with it another community-requested change!
In our mission to reduce plattforming and improve actual puzzle-solving we completely redesigned the puzzle in Chapter 6 Level 4! Have a small sneak peek right here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360336/e809be90b9d3225fbed2fb329717a7a83835d226.png[/img]

As always: thank you so very much for your support and we all hope that you'll continue to enjoy your time on OPIS! 💖

notes.title: Quality-of-Life Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]Good Day Archaeologists![/h2]

It is time to present you our first [b]major update[/b] for Faraday Protocol! The [b]QoL-Update[/b] focuses on bringing our level designs to the next level by addressing one of the major issues our players had with some of the puzzles: [b]the platforming segments[/b]!

Many puzzle rooms have been [b]redesigned and tweaked[/b] by either reducing the amount of platforming you have to do or even by removing full platforming segments and replacing them with new and exciting puzzles!

[b]Take a quick look at the changes right here![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360336/0e79e5bdff393b230a930c1c0d380068dd5dbb18.gif[/img]

In addition to those major changes, we also fixed and tweaked some [b]minor issues and potential softlocks[/b] to give you a hopefully smooth ride through the space station OPIS!

Please let us know what you think of the changes - we can't wait to hear your opinions! Either on Steam or on our game's [url=http://discord.gg/23NekDsBv9]Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/FaradayProtocol]Twitter[/url]!

[b]Thank you so much![/b]

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Archaeologists![/h2]

We published a new update fixing two minor issues: the achievement "[b]Explorer[/b]" not unlocking and SteamVR popping up on systems that have it installed! 🎉
With this you should now be able to properly get every achievement in the game! We're very sorry for the inconvenience!

And before we give over to the changelog: if you like our game (or even if you didn't like it), please let us know in the [b]Steam reviews[/b]! And if you'd like to chat about the game with other players or the developers at Red Koi Box, you can join our [b]Discord [/b]as well - thanks! ♥

[list]
[*]Join our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/23NekDsBv9]https://discord.gg/23NekDsBv9[/url]
[*]Follow us on Twitter: [url=http://twitter.com/FaradayProtocol]http://twitter.com/FaradayProtocol[/url]
[/list]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed "Explorer" achievement not unlocking
[*]Fixed SteamVR starting with the game on systems that have it installed
[/list]
